VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report claims the fix is complete and all 28 tests pass, but provides no independent verification. Without CI logs, diffs, test output, or other corroborating evidence (SIGN, WIT, REC, ATT, or PROOF class), the self-report alone cannot satisfy acceptance criteria that explicitly require "all 28 tests pass." Self-reports are inherently unreliable for verifying test suite status, especially for off-by-one bugs where subtle errors are common.
